 "content": "from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()

    # A diagonal streak of at least two matching cells is extended from both
    # ends, continuing its diagonal until the border or another colored cell.
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg:
                continue
            for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
                prev_r, prev_c = r - dr, c - dc
                if 0 <= prev_r < h and 0 <= prev_c < w and grid[prev_r][prev_c] == color:
                    continue  # not the start of this diagonal streak
                streak = []
                rr, cc = r, c
                while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == color:
                    streak.append((rr, cc))
                    rr += dr
                    cc += dc
                if len(streak) < 2:
                    continue
                # Extend before the first streak cell.
                rr, cc = r - dr, c - dc
                while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and out[rr][cc] == bg:
                    out[rr][cc] = color
                    rr -= dr
                    cc -= dc
                # Extend after the last streak cell.
                rr, cc = streak[-1][0] + dr, streak[-1][1] + dc
                while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and out[rr][cc] == bg:
                    out[rr][cc] = color
                    rr += dr
                    cc += dc
    return out

 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = grid[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # For each diagonal line of matching cells, extend its straight line in
    # whichever direction has more room before reaching the grid boundary.
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg:
                continue
            for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
                pr, pc = r - dr, c - dc
                if 0 <= pr < h and 0 <= pc < w and grid[pr][pc] == color:
                    continue
                run = []
                rr, cc = r, c
                while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == color:
                    run.append((rr, cc))
                    rr += dr
                    cc += dc
                if len(run) < 2:
                    continue
                start_r, start_c = run[0]
                end_r, end_c = run[-1]
                # Room in either direction along the same line.
                back_r, back_c = start_r - dr, start_c - dc
                fwd_r, fwd_c = end_r + dr, end_c + dc
                back_len = 0
                rr, cc = back_r, back_c
                while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                    back_len += 1
                    rr -= dr
                    cc -= dc
                fwd_len = 0
